label.issue: Problem getting a card or closing an account

arguments.issue: Problem getting a card or closing an account

messages.content:
You convert one CFPB complaint into exactly one strict JSON ticket. The user input is
input-contract-v2 JSON with complaint_id, narrative, source_product, source_issue,
and source_company. Return JSON only, with exactly: product, issue, company, urgency,
ambiguity_flag, and tool_call.

product is one of card, credit_reporting, debt_collection, deposit_account,
money_service, mortgage, payday_personal_loan, student_loan, vehicle_loan. Map CFPB
products by meaning: cards/prepaid -> card; credit reporting/repair/consumer reports
or debt/credit management -> credit_reporting; debt collection -> debt_collection;
bank/checking/savings -> deposit_account; transfers/virtual currency/money service ->
money_service; mortgage -> mortgage; payday/title/personal/advance loan ->
payday_personal_loan; student loan -> student_loan; consumer/vehicle loan or lease ->
vehicle_loan. issue is the nonempty source issue, or "unspecified". company is the
source company or null.

Urgency policy: high if the narrative contains foreclosure, eviction, identity
theft, garnishment, repossession, threatened to take legal action, unable to access
funds, or account takeover. Otherwise medium if source_issue plus narrative contains
fraud, unauthorized, dispute, incorrect information, late fee, collection, charged,
or denied. Otherwise low. Match Unicode-normalized, collapsed, case-insensitive text.

Ambiguity means source_issue or source_company is missing, normalized narrative is
under 40 characters, or a narrative of at most 200 characters contains "not sure",
"do not know what happened", "don't know what happened", "insufficient information",
or "no details available". ambiguity_flag is true exactly when the tool is
request_more_info.

Choose the first applicable tool: (1) request_more_info for ambiguity; (2)
close_no_action if issue plus narrative says resolved, filed in error, or duplicate;
(3) escalate_to_regulator for high urgency; (4) start_refund_workflow if narrative
contains refund, reimbursement, money back, reverse the charge, or chargeback; (5)
route_to_company otherwise.

Tool arguments must have exactly one registered shape:
- request_more_info: missing_fields (unique values from product, issue, company,
  details) and a meaningful question.
- close_no_action: reason = already_resolved, duplicate_or_spam, or
  no_consumer_harm_detected.
- escalate_to_regulator: complaint_id integer and meaningful nonempty reason.
- start_refund_workflow: company string, issue string, evidence_required true.
- route_to_company: company string and issue string.
No Markdown, reasoning, comments, or extra fields.

{"complaint_id":2795274,"narrative":"Received unsolicited prepaid card by mail on XX/XX/2018. cardholder agreement under fee schedule states '' If you do not register your card and your card remains inactive, we will access the Account Maintence Fee Listed below beginning 90 days after the date the card was acquired. '' called to remove account but was an automated call with no way to verify it was removed. E mailed to the listed email address to decline card but address was invalid.","source_company":"Netspend Corporation","source_issue":"Problem getting a card or closing an account","source_product":"Credit card or prepaid card"}

{"complaint_id":2640210,"narrative":"After receiving calls from \" Genesis Financial, '' I sent a request for validation in writing, as well as a cease and desist notice of communication with third parties or anyone other than myself as I would correspond with them directly. They noted this on the account last week per their representative I spoke with, yet not only called my mom the day after I asked them not to and they confirmed, but today my employer also got a notice from them which I have not yet even received. I have reviewed and attached the notice that was sent to my employer, and as this notice should have been provided to me, and per the phone call with Genesis Financial on speaker phone while in the payroll office at my place of employment, the person at Genesis said when I asked what my employer was supposed to do with this \"  notice, '' she said nothing. '' Again then, if this notice had nothing that needed to be done by my employer, it should n't have been sent to them in the first place, and should have been sent to me as requested. I specifically asked them to send me written correspondence regarding this \" account, '' provided them with my contact information to make sure they had everything they needed, only to have them continue to send correspondence to third parties without even sending it to me directly so I have a chance to dispute and/or respond appropriately. I have requested validation and verification of this \" account '' in writing, and while I am waiting for them to mail me that information, they continue to violate a cease and desist communication with third parties after they confirmed receipt of that last week, and acknowledged to me they received it and would not contact anyone other than myself. This should apply to written correspondence as well as the phone calls to my \" references '' as they indicated. Per that request, written notification should be provided to me BEFORE it is sent to an employer, or shared with anyone else.","source_company":"Genesis Financial & Payment Systems Holdings, LLC","source_issue":"Threatened to contact someone or share information improperly","source_product":"Debt collection"}

{"complaint_id":4091262,"narrative":"On XX/XX/XXXX my account was closed by Pnc they froze all my funds I called them to see what was going on they told me it was up to the bank to end the relationship so I went to the branch where I opened the account I spoke to the banker that opened my account he spoke to one of the departments and he was told It was an issue verifying my information he explained it was a typo on his end asked if he could fix the issue and have my account remain open or release my funds to me they also told him no so on XX/XX/XXXX I spoke with XXXX XXXX from retails she acted as if she could help me or better assist me but then she turns around and says sorry its nothing more she can do my account is closed I have to wait 7-10 business days for a cashier check then on XX/XX/XXXX I spoke with some from the retail department because I had a XXXX sent to that It was for XXXX $ and it says pending so I called and they were like your account isnt closed its on hold and Im like last week I was told it was closed and he reassured me it wasnt so at this point Im seeking a lawyer because my account was closed because of error made by the bank also my funds was taking away from me during a pandemic and Im a mother of three and I have bills to pay also I was told my funds couldnt be released to me because it was closed then to find out its not is wrong because when I was at the branch they could have given me a cashier check then","source_company":"PNC Bank N.A.","source_issue":"Managing an account","source_product":"Checking or savings account"}
